content.title: Jimmy Kimmel to return as host for 2023 Oscars - IMDb
content.text: Jimmy Kimmel to return as host for 2023 OscarsJimmy Kimmel will be returning to front the 95th Oscars in 2023, marking the talk show host’s third time presenting the ceremony.Kimmel first hosted the awards in 2017, the year that La La Land was mistakenly announced as the Best Picture winner over Moonlight, the true winner. The second time he hosted was in 2018.The Jimmy Kimmel Live host’s return was announced by Glenn Weiss and Ricky Kirshner, the executive producers and showrunners of the Academy Awards.“Being invited to host the Oscars for a third time is either a great honour or a trap,” Kimmel said in a statement. “Either way, I am grateful to the Academy for asking me so quickly after everyone good said no.”Last year, the event was hosted by trio Amy Schumer, Wanda Sykes and Regina Hall, with Apple TV movie Coda winning Best Picture.The Whale, The Banshees of Inisherin and Elvis...Den vollständigen Artikel findest du unter The Independent - Film7.11.2022von Ellie HarrisonThe Independent - FilmÄhnliche NeuigkeitenJimmy KimmelStephen Colbert rips Trump’s poll Numbers and 'cut and run' plan in Iran1.4.2026von Matt MooreLast Night OnNew Laws Aim to Protect Kids Online.
